001package pkg_commands;
002
003import pkg_engine.GameEngine;
004
005/**
006 * Base type for all executable player commands.
007 *
008 * <p>The parser creates a concrete command object and stores the optional second token here before
009 * the command is executed.
010 *
011 * @author Barnabe Jouanard
012 * @version 2026.05.08
013 */
014public abstract class Command {
015    /** Optional second token; {@code null} if none was supplied. */
016    private String aSecondWord;
017
018    /** Creates a command with no second word. */
019    public Command() {
020        this.aSecondWord = null;
021    } // Command()
022
023    /**
024     * Returns the second word of this command, if any.
025     *
026     * @return the second token, or {@code null}
027     */
028    public String getSecondWord() {
029        return this.aSecondWord;
030    } // getSecondWord()
031
032    /**
033     * Replaces the optional second word before execution.
034     *
035     * @param pSecondWord the new second word, or {@code null}
036     */
037    public void setSecondWord(final String pSecondWord) {
038        this.aSecondWord = pSecondWord;
039    } // setSecondWord()
040
041    /**
042     * Indicates whether a second token was present.
043     *
044     * @return {@code true} if {@link #getSecondWord()} is not {@code null}
045     */
046    public boolean hasSecondWord() {
047        return this.aSecondWord != null;
048    } // hasSecondWord()
049
050    /**
051     * Indicates whether this command is unknown.
052     *
053     * @return always {@code false}; unknown input is represented by {@code null} commands
054     */
055    public boolean isUnknown() {
056        return false;
057    } // isUnknown()
058
059    /**
060     * Executes the command against the current game engine.
061     *
062     * @param pGameEngine the game engine to update
063     * @return {@code true} when the command requests that the game ends
064     */
065    public abstract boolean execute(final GameEngine pGameEngine);
066} // Command
